name: Montage Los Cabos, Mexico
positioning: Montage Los Cabos: a low-density beach resort on 39 acres along calm Santa Maria Bay, on the Golden Corridor between Cabo San Lucas and San Jose del Cabo
best_for: Beach lovers who want a calm bay where they can wade in and swim
Travelers who want a quiet base about 20 minutes by taxi from both Cabo towns
Guests interested in spa rituals and wellness, including vegan dining options

facts.text: The resort spans 39 acres along Santa Maria Bay.
The hotel is set on the Golden Corridor, an undeveloped stretch between the hotel zones of Cabo San Lucas and San Jose del Cabo.
The landscaping uses native and drought-tolerant plants such as rock figs, agave and saguaro instead of green lawns.
Interiors use creamy sandstone, indigenous hardwood, updated equipale chairs, and woven throws and wall hangings.
The buildings are low-slung and low-density.
Guests who want sea breezes and whale-spotting from their terrace can request a room close to the water.
Marea, the more casual restaurant, has a separate vegan menu.
Paletas is a marketplace selling handicrafts and gifts, where guests can also grab a cafe con leche and pan dulce.
Spa Montage rituals are inspired by the rhythms of the ocean and the local traditions of Baja California Sur.
Full-day cabana rentals are available at the pool or on the beach.

highlights.text: The hotel faces the calm Santa Maria Bay, a Cabo beach without big breaking waves where guests can wade right in and swim.
Montage Los Cabos is the first international hotel from the American-based Montage group.
The spa offers guided journeys with the hotel's resident shaman.
Talay serves Thai-inspired street-food dishes from a food truck setup.
The resort offers complimentary scuba discovery sessions for beginner divers.

considerations.text: The resort sits on an undeveloped stretch of coast; the town centers of Cabo San Lucas and San Jose del Cabo are each about a 20-minute taxi ride away.
WhataHotel notes premium luxury pricing reflecting the high-end positioning.

sources.title: Conde Nast Traveler: Montage Los Cabos
